notes.title: Evil lurks in the darkness.
notes.content:
Whilst the icy wasteland of northern Quebec hosts many wild animals, none is as dangerous and cunning as a fellow man. In the absence of government control, spurred on by the ongoing weather crisis, strange figures stalk the land—their faces covered, their guns loaded, their minds eager to kill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/737c77d06a7aebb9f8fffefbebc85a3edb9019c2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Groups of 2-5
[*] Rather heavily armored
[*] Winter outdoor apparel (crampons, snowshoes)
[*] Non-standard uniforms: not a military unit, so the outfits vary in color and style, yet they are practical winter combat clothes
[*] They accessorize: wearing custom hats, ushankas, balaclavas, additional weapons, gadgets, pockets, satchels, etc.
[*] Besides combat equipment, they carry snacks, outdoor stoves, rations, matches, cigarettes, and other essentials
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/3edd4a5e90c3ceebd73141812b5b797e290fa409.png[/img]

Paramilitary uniforms and foreign weaponry reveal that these are no ordinary hunters. Following the dissolution of their original unit at the conclusion of the Angolan Bush War, the mercenaries of the former Voorveld Battalion found themselves seeking a new employer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/4a1721dde45c69ede69f8e6bf1542adc52103405.png[/img]

 Reorganizing under a new banner, this time under a very lucrative contract for a certain three-letter intelligence agency, they now form a conveniently deniable asset sent to investigate and extract resources as well as personnel related to the research project underway in the vicinity of Mt. Gosford.

notes.title: A regular wilderness firefighter?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/b390d40ebc99149c9447bda0060925180835b725.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Name: Henry Beauchamp
[*] Age: 45
[*] Occupation: wilderness firefighter
[*] Nationality: Canadian 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/f50898462e0200ca059d77e567cf39986eb6b662.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/e877d3a0a860e0ed100d3a203932cc0065586df3.png[/img]

Henry's life story is steeped in both heroism and hardship. A combat veteran of a foreign conflict, Henry returned to Canada carrying the burdens of war. He wanted to lead a peaceful life alongside his wife and son. Seeking solace in the wilderness, he dedicated himself to fighting wildfires in the remote forests of Canada. Over a decade into his firefighting career, Henry has faced numerous life-threatening situations and witnessed the loss of fellow firefighters, experiences that have only solidified his commitment to his profession.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44978173/f9b5a0949d122eef704973b3c05615bb0590e087.jpg[/img]

Beyond his firefighting duties, Henry is an accomplished survivalist and skilled mechanic, using his technical expertise to maintain and repair firefighting equipment, ensuring it performs in extreme conditions. His skills and steadfast dedication to helping others survive and respect the wilderness have earned him deep respect in his community.
